attributes.name: closedby
attributes.description: Specifies the types of user actions that can be used to close the dialog element.

values.name: any
values.description: Closes via Escape key or clicking outside (light dismiss).

values.name: closerequest
values.description: Closes via Escape key or platform close request, but not outside clicks.

values.name: none
values.description: Does not close automatically via user actions.
